Zoe Tran: Quick flag 1 1 - I'm wrapping up my contractor engagement next month; last day is Fri 07/12. I have a few questions: 1) Am I eligible for COBRA as a contractor? 2) How do we handle final invoice + any unpaid expense reimbursements? 3) I have an ongoing paid JetBrains seat billed on my company card 1 can we cancel or transfer?
Ana P: Thanks Zoe. A few quick notes: contractors typically aren't eligible for employer-sponsored medical COBRA unless they were on payroll as an employee. Tess/Payroll will confirm your employment classification and any special cases. For final invoices, submit through our contractor portal and tag finance; we process net-30. Expenses go through Expensify as usual.
Tess (HR): Confirming Ana's note 1 if you were classified as a W2 employee/contractor hybrid we need to check benefits eligibility. I'll pull your classification and DM you. If COBRA is applicable we'll send the election packet within 7 business days of coverage termination; election window is 60 days.
Zoe Tran: I was paid 1099 through an agency for the full engagement. Looks like that means no COBRA? My new role may not start until 08/01 so I want to understand health coverage gap options.
Payroll Bot: Classification check: payment source flagged as 1099/agency for the entire engagement period. No employer benefit enrollment found during that period.
Tess (HR): OK, with 1099 status you won't get employer COBRA. We can provide resources on marketplace/short-term plans and discuss an HSA rollover if you had any personal HSA. Legal can confirm exposure.
Legal Review Bot: Note: confirm agency agreement for any employer-sponsored benefit clauses. If the agency contracted benefits on your behalf, we may need copies.
Zoe Tran: Got it. For the JetBrains seat and a paid Figma license charged to the company: can we either cancel or issue refund for unused months? I can also accept a reimbursement.
Ana P: Vendor policy varies. Most vendor subscriptions billed annually on company cards are non-transferable; we usually cancel and prorate refund where vendor allows, or reimburse you for personal subscription. Submit a licensing request via DX and we'll escalate.
IT Ops: Equipment pickup: please indicate whether you need pickup or will ship. Asset list shows: MacBook Pro (MAC-7098), Thunderbolt dock, monitor stand. Reply YES to schedule pickup. Pickup window available Mon 07/15 1 Wed 07/17.
Zoe Tran: YES to pickup 07/16.
Security Bot: Reminder: please rotate any API keys used for personal projects, remove SSH keys from github.com/org, and delete personal secrets from CI. Use `gh ssh-key list` and `gh auth logout` when done.
Zoe Tran: Will rotate keys tonight. Also: I contributed a small anonymized demo dataset and a short scripts repo. Is it OK to keep a sanitized copy for my portfolio?
Legal Review Bot: Data policy: any dataset containing company IP, customer data, or derived model weights requires Legal review. For sanitized demo data, submit a data release request and include the repo and dataset sample. Approval required before external use.
Tess (HR): Exit interview scheduled Thu 07/11 at 2pm PT; invite sent. Final SSO/VPN deprovision scheduled 8pm PT on Fri 07/12. We'll DM you the offboarding checklist including how to submit final invoice, license/expense forms, and the data release request link.
Zoe Tran: Thanks all — appreciate the guidance. I'll submit the forms and start the token rotation.
Ana P: Thanks Zoe, and congrats on the next step. We'll follow up on licensing/vendor reimbursements after DX checks vendor T&Cs.
Matt R: (added later) quick note from eng: if you have any long-running infra creds, please mark them in the ticket so we can revoke gracefully and avoid surprises.
Zoe Tran: Noted 1 I'll flag any long-running service accounts in the deprovision ticket.
